Oscar-winning directors face citizenship threat over Gaza film

Israeli directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, who won an Oscar for their documentary NAZA, are facing threats of citizenship revocation and accusations of treason. The film industry globally has rallied in support of the directors following these threats. The documentary focuses on the Gaza Strip.
